lead.headline: 164.8 to 132.76 and they are done: the first win is in
lead.deck: Kamara played through a back injury for five touches, Monangai is week-to-week in a boot, and Jefferson, Gordon and the defence are off next week.
lead.body: Start with the bad news about your own players, and it is all on the bench or next week. Alvin Kamara had five touches for 2.6; he had been questionable all week with a back injury (SI, 9 Oct), and CBS ties the back to Kendre Miller out-carrying him by seven. Kyle Monangai is in a walking boot with turf toe, week-to-week and not on injured reserve, with nothing said since the game. Jordan Addison has no timetable and Jalen Coker has not practised since his quad. Next week Minnesota and Miami are off: Justin Jefferson, Ollie Gordon and the Vikings' defence all leave your lineup at once. The result: Los Gigantes de Teca finished at 132.76 on Sunday night, and you have 164.8 with Josh Allen still to play on Monday. That is your first win. The lineup was the projection lineup: Jaylen Warren scored 36.8 on an 80-yard catch and a 50-yard run, Isaiah Likely 32.4 on 13 targets, Garrett Wilson 23.4 and Jefferson 18.8. Tuesday's brief, the last before Wednesday's 01:00 claims, names the Week 6 flex and defence from projections that do not exist yet.
